statement: For every integer k >= 1, the number of acyclic orientations of P_3 square P_{2k+1} is congruent to 2 modulo 4. More strongly, psi(P_3 square P_m) is congruent to 2 modulo 4 for every integer m >= 2.
contribution: A complete two-state chromatic-polynomial transfer proof settles the frozen width-three infinite family, and in fact all strip lengths m >= 2. This resolves the question relative to the cited source without asserting broader priority. The first previously unreported case m=9 is also certified by independent exact deletion-contraction and full Fortuin-Kasteleyn chromatic-polynomial computations.
